name: ithyno-vscode
description: ithyno dashboard for the OpenSpec workflow, embedded in VS Code as a webview panel.

ithyno.terminalStartup.description: Command auto-launched when the ithyno terminal is created. Empty (the default) means ithyno auto-manages a per-project Claude Code session id in `.ithyno/session-id` — mints on first launch (`claude --session-id <uuid>`) and resumes thereafter (`claude --resume <uuid>`). Set explicitly to override: `claude` for fresh-every-time, `claude --continue` for the legacy behavior, or any custom command.

ithyno.autoLaunchTerminal.description: When true (the default), opening the ithyno dashboard immediately creates the `ithyno` VS Code Terminal and runs the startup command (see `ithyno.terminalStartup`) — but only when `agents.yaml` is present at the project root. Projects without `agents.yaml` never auto-launch (a plain shell is still available via explicit terminal commands). When false, the terminal is created lazily on the first button press (Apply / Archive / Merge / Run).

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run prepack:host && node scripts/vsix-package.mjs
